svg.title: Now the coarser main placements occupy distinct larger cells, and no one of them occupies a larger cell containing a finer exterior placement: otherwise the cell’s extent would contradict the assumed main-main or main-exterior separation. Put each main field in its own cell, and each collected exterior product in its occupied cell. One application of the larger chessboard inequality bounds the full mixed product by the product of their root tests. Multiplying the collected bounds gives exactly Q Bi Q Dj. Thus the different insertion scales are retained; replacing them by a single common scale is unnecessary.
